}}'''Casagrand''' Premier Builder Limited is an Indian real estate developer headquartered in [[Chennai]], [[Tamil Nadu]] established in 2003. The company develops residential and mixed-use projects across South India. In 2024, its subsidiary Casagrand Premier received approval from the [[Securities and Exchange Board of India]] (SEBI) for an initial public offering. 

== History ==
Casagrand traces its origins to the early 2000s and was formally incorporated in 2003.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Casagrand Gets Sebi Nod For Rs 1,100 Crore IPO |url=https://www.rprealtyplus.com/realty-spotlight/casagrand-gets-sebi-nod-for-rs-1100-crore-ipo-118309.html |access-date=2025-11-12 |website=Realty Plus Magazine |language=en}}</ref> In 2004, Casagrand launched its first project, Casagrand Srishti in [[Thiruvanmiyur]]. In 2006, the company delivered its first major project, Casagrand Rivera.{{cn|date=December 2025}} In 2014, the company entered Bengaluru with its debut project, Casagrand Luxus.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Casagrand Builder Private Limited Information - Casagrand Builder Private Limited Company Profile, Casagrand Builder Private Limited News on The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/company/casagrand-builder-private-limited/U70101TN2003PTC051989 |access-date=2025-11-15 |website=The Economic Times |language=en}}</ref> 

In 2019, Casagrand launched Asta, described as Chennai's first kids-themed project, followed by Royale, Zenith, and Boulevard in 2020. The company later developed Athens, a sports-themed project in West Chennai, and Vistaaz in 2021, a villa development at Perungalathur.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2019-11-16 |title=Casagrand Builders - Construction Week India |url=https://www.constructionweekonline.in/lists/11348-casagrand-builders |access-date=2025-11-15 |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2020-10-08 |title=Casagrand launches 5th project - Casagrand Boulevard - Construction Week India |url=https://www.constructionweekonline.in/projects-tenders/15293-casagrand-launches-5th-project-casagrand-boulevard |access-date=2025-11-15 |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=CASAGRAND Launches CASAGRAND Zenith, a Wellness Community at Medavakkam |url=https://www.rprealtyplus.com/news-views/casagrand-launches-casagrand-zenith-a-wellness-community-at-medavakkam-65244.html |access-date=2025-11-15 |website=Realty Plus Magazine |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2019-11-09 |title=CASAGRAND Royale has unique kids-friendly features - Construction Week India |url=https://www.constructionweekonline.in/projects-tenders/11203-casagrand-royale-launched-by-casagrand-has-unique-kids-friendly-features |access-date=2025-11-15 |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2020-11-23 |title=CASAGRAND launches sports themed apartment community 'CASAGRAND Athens' |url=https://mediabrief.com/casagrand-launches-casagrand-athens/ |access-date=2025-11-15 |website=MediaBrief |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-02-26 |title=Casagrand launches Chennai’s first British styled villa community Casagrand Vistaaz at Perungalathur - Construction Week India |url=https://www.constructionweekonline.in/projects-tenders/16780-casagrand-launches-chennais-first-british-styled-villa-community-casagrand-vistaaz-at-perungalathur |access-date=2025-11-15 |language=en-US}}</ref>

In 2020, Casagrand appointed actor [[R. Madhavan]] as its brand ambassador for Chennai and Bengaluru.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2020-10-08 |title=Casagrand launches 5th project - Casagrand Boulevard - Construction Week India |url=https://www.constructionweekonline.in/projects-tenders/15293-casagrand-launches-5th-project-casagrand-boulevard |access-date=2025-11-12 |language=en-US}}</ref>

In 2022, Casagrand planned to expand into new markets, including investments of ₹1,500 crore in Bengaluru and Hyderabad, and a ₹450 crore residential project in Bengaluru.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-09-23 |title=Casagrand plans to acquire land parcels worth Rs 10,000 crore - Construction Week India |url=https://www.constructionweekonline.in/projects-tenders/19718-casagrand-plans-to-acquire-land-parcels-worth-rs-10000-crore |access-date=2025-11-15 |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=CASAGRAND to invest Rs 450 crore in kids-themed project in Bengaluru |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/real-estate/casagrand-to-invest-rs-450-crore-in-kids-themed-project-in-bengaluru-9073551.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220828123631/https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/real-estate/casagrand-to-invest-rs-450-crore-in-kids-themed-project-in-bengaluru-9073551.html |archive-date=2022-08-28 |access-date=2025-11-15 |website=Moneycontrol |language=en-US |url-status=live }}</ref>

In August 2022, Casagrand launched Casagrand Perch, focused on constructing 500 individual houses in Chennai, Bengaluru, and Coimbatore.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Standard |first=Business |title=Casagrand forays into home building segment, plans 500 homes in 3 years |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/casagrand-forays-into-home-building-segment-plans-500-homes-in-3-years-122083100297_1.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250322071442/https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/casagrand-forays-into-home-building-segment-plans-500-homes-in-3-years-122083100297_1.html |archive-date=2025-03-22 |access-date=2025-11-15 |website=www.business-standard.com |language=en-US |url-status=live }}</ref> Around the same time, the company announced a ₹2,000 crore investment in Bengaluru and plans to invest ₹8,000 crore in Maharashtra for the development of 20 million sq ft of residential space.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-05-03 |title=Casagrand to invest Rs 2000cr in Bangalore - Construction Week India |url=https://www.constructionweekonline.in/projects-tenders/casagrand-to-invest-rs-2000cr-in-bangalore |access-date=2025-11-15 |language=en-US}}</ref> In August 2023, Casagrand appointed cricket legend [[Sourav Ganguly]] as its national brand ambassador.<ref>{{Cite web |last=www.ETBrandEquity.com |title=Casagrand partners with Sourav Ganguly |url=https://brandequity.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/marketing/casagrand-partners-with-sourav-ganguly/102906999 |access-date=2025-11-15 |website=ETBrandEquity.com |language=en}}</ref> Also, the company bought over 4 lakh square feet of land in a deal valued at around Rs 56.8 crore.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Khan |first=Sobia |date=2023-08-22 |title=Casa Grande has bought over 4 lakh square feet of land in a deal valued at around Rs 56.8 crore in Hyderabad |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/services/property-/-cstruction/casa-grande-has-bought-over-4-lakh-square-feet-of-land-in-a-deal-valued-at-around-rs-56-8-crore-in-hyderabad/articleshow/102949914.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2025-11-15 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}}</ref> In May 2024, Casagrand launched “Casagrand HolaChennai,” a 30-acre township in Sholinganallur (OMR), Chennai with 1,818 homes (apartments and villas).<ref>{{Cite web |title=Casagrand Launches 30-Acre Township At Once-In-A-Lifetime Pricing |url=https://www.rprealtyplus.com/newsviews/casagrand-launches-30-acre-township-at-once-in-a-lifetime-pricing-115036.html |access-date=2025-11-15 |website=Realty Plus Magazine |language=en}}</ref>

In September 2024, Casagrand Premier filed its draft [[red herring prospectus]] (DRHP) with [[Securities and Exchange Board of India|SEBI]] for an [[initial public offering]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Goel |first=Saloni |date=2025-01-08 |title=Casagrand Premier Builder receives Sebi nod to launch ₹1,100 crore IPO {{!}} Stock Market News |url=https://www.livemint.com/market/ipo/casagrand-premier-builder-receives-sebi-nod-to-launch-rs-1-100-crore-ipo-11736338597700.html |access-date=2025-11-15 |website=mint |language=en}}</ref> In December 2024, the company received SEBI's final observations (approval) for its ₹1,100 crore IPO.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Khan |first=Sobia |date=2025-01-08 |title=Chennai based Casagrand Premier Builder gets Sebi nod for Rs 1,100 crore IPO |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/ipos/fpos/chennai-based-Casagrand-premier-builder-gets-sebi-nod-for-rs-1100-crore-ipo/articleshow/117058553.cms |access-date=2025-11-15 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}}</ref> In January 2025, Casagrand entered the [[Tiruppur]] market.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-01-28 |title=Casagrand comes with Highline in Tiruppur in Chennai |url=https://www.constructionweekonline.in/projects-tenders/casagrand-highline-will-have-137-apartments-and-36-4-bhk-villas |access-date=2025-11-15 |language=en-US}}</ref>

In 2025, it appointed [[Venkatesh (actor)|Venkatesh Daggubati]] as its brand ambassador for the Hyderabad region.<ref>{{Cite web |last=www.ETBrandEquity.com |title=Casagrand onboards Venkatesh Daggubati as its brand ambassador |url=https://brandequity.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/advertising/casagrand-onboards-venkatesh-daggubati-as-its-brand-ambassador/119943139 |access-date=2025-11-15 |website=ETBrandEquity.com |language=en}}</ref> In July 2025, Casagrand announced its first project in Pune, Upper Kharadi, and named Bollywood actors [[Genelia D'Souza|Genelia]] and [[Riteish Deshmukh]] as brand ambassadors for the western India market.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Ramamirtham |first=Anuradha |date=2025-07-02 |title=Casagrand launches Casagrand Caladium in Upper Kharadi, Pune |url=https://housing.com/news/casagrand-launches-first-project-in-pune-genelia-and-riteish-deshmukh-are-brand-ambassadors/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250904174033/https://housing.com/news/casagrand-launches-first-project-in-pune-genelia-and-riteish-deshmukh-are-brand-ambassadors/ |archive-date=2025-09-04 |access-date=2025-11-15 |work=Housing News |language=en-GB |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=www.ETBrandEquity.com |title=Casagrand onboards Genelia and Riteish Deshmukh as its brand ambassadors for West India |url=https://brandequity.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/advertising/casagrand-onboards-genelia-and-riteish-deshmukh-as-its-brand-ambassadors-for-west-india/122247433 |access-date=2025-11-15 |website=ETBrandEquity.com |language=en}}</ref>

Later that year the company launched a project in Dubai.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-07-24 |title=Casagrand forays in to UAE with first project in Dubai |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/news/real-estate/casagrand-forays-in-to-uae-with-first-project-in-dubai/article69850461.ece |access-date=2025-11-15 |website=BusinessLine |language=en}}</ref> In 2025, Casagrand has launched 2 more projects in Bengaluru Casagrand Promenade in Yelahanka and Casagrand Estancia in Kogilu.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-05-13 |title=Casagrand Promenade is coming up at Yelahanka in Bangalore |url=https://www.constructionweekonline.in/projects-tenders/casagrand-promenade |access-date=2025-11-15 |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Casagrand Launches Estancia in North Bengaluru - Times Property |url=https://timesproperty.com/news/post/casagrand-launches-estancia-in-kogilu-blid10618 |access-date=2025-11-15 |website=timesproperty}}</ref>

As of 2025, Casagrand had completed over 100 projects, covering several million square feet of residential and mixed-use development.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-09-23 |title=Casagrand Premier Builder files papers with SEBI for Rs 1,100-cr IPO |url=https://www.business-standard.com/markets/ipo/casagrand-premier-builder-files-papers-with-sebi-for-rs-1-100-cr-ipo-124092300609_1.html |access-date=2025-11-15 |website=Business Standard}}</ref>

== Other activities ==
Casagrand operates an employee reward programme, started in 2013, offering fully paid international trips for staff. About 6,000 employees have travelled to destinations such as London, Singapore, Switzerland, and Dubai.<ref>{{Cite web |last=www.ETHRWorld.com |title=Work Hard, Party Harder: This real estate developer sends its employees on international trips every year |url=https://hr.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/trends/employee-experience/work-hard-party-harder-this-real-estate-developer-sends-its-employees-on-international-trips-every-year/120807752 |access-date=2025-11-15 |website=ETHRWorld.com |language=en}}</ref>

In 2022, about 700 employees were sent to Switzerland after meeting sales targets, and in 2024, around 1,000 employees visited Barcelona, Spain, under the same programme.<ref>{{Cite web |last=www.ETHRWorld.com |title=Casagrand rewards 700 employees with a week-long trip to Switzerland |url=https://hr.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/hrtech/payroll-and-benefits/casagrand-rewards-700-employees-with-a-week-long-trip-to-switzerland/95831790 |access-date=2025-11-15 |website=ETHRWorld.com |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Livemint |date=2024-11-21 |title=From Barcelona beaches to Montjuïc Castle: Chennai’s Casagrand sends 1,000 employees on dream ‘all-paid’ Spain trip {{!}} Company Business News |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/chennaibased-casagrand-treats-1-000-employees-to-luxurious-all-expenses-paid-spain-getaway-barcelona-montju-c-castle-11732162435541.html |access-date=2025-11-15 |website=mint |language=en}}</ref> In August 2025, Casagrand arranged a train trip to Goa for 800 employees in collaboration with [[Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation|IRCTC]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Casagrand Charters Exclusive Train, Taking 800 Employees on a Memorable Offsite to Goa |url=https://expressnews.asia/2025/08/casagrand-charters-exclusive-train-taking-800-employees-on-a-memorable-offsite-to-goa/ |access-date=2025-11-15 |website=Expressnews |language=en-US}}</ref> Through its Casagrand Aspiring Stars programme, launched in 2015, the company funds coaching, training, and equipment for emerging sportspersons.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Press Trust of India |title=3 young sportsperson receive sponsorships |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/pti-stories/3-young-sportsperson-receive-sponsorships-120010800493_1.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200109145732/https://www.business-standard.com/article/pti-stories/3-young-sportsperson-receive-sponsorships-120010800493_1.html |archive-date=2020-01-09 |access-date=2025-11-15 |language=en |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=cityairnews |date=2021-08-28 |title=Casagrand in association with Tamil Nadu Athletic Association honors Olympians of Tamil Nadu |url=https://www.cityairnews.com/content/casagrand-in-association-with-tamil-nadu-athletic-association-honors-olympians-of-tamil-nadu |access-date=2025-11-15 |website=Cityairnews |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Service |first=Express News |date=2015-01-13 |title=Nurturing Young Tennis Talent |url=https://www.newindianexpress.com/cities/chennai/2015/Jan/13/nurturing-young-tennis-talent-704740.html |access-date=2025-11-15 |website=The New Indian Express |language=en}}</ref>   

=== Sponsorships ===
Between 2021 and 2025, Casagrand appointed several film actors as brand ambassadors for its projects, including [[Vijay Sethupathi]] (FirstCity, Chennai), [[Khushbu Sundar]] (Flagship, Chennai), [[Prakash Raj]] (Aquene, Bengaluru), [[Hrithik Roshan]] (Mercury), [[Nayanthara]] (Casamia, Chennai), and [[Nani (actor)|Nani]] (Evon, Hyderabad).<ref>{{Cite web |last=Staff |first=exchange4media |date=2021-10-01 |title=Vijay Sethupathi to endorse CASAGRAND FirstCity - Exchange4media |url=https://www.exchange4media.com/marketing-news/vijay-sethupathi-to-endorse-casagrand-firstcity-116040.html |access-date=2025-11-15 |website=Indian Advertising Media & Marketing News – exchange4media |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-01-05 |title=Casagrand ropes in Kushboo Sundar to endorse its residential project 'Casagrand Flagship' at Pallikaranai |url=https://www.medianews4u.com/casagrand-ropes-in-kushboo-sundar-to-endorse-its-residential-project-casagrand-flagship-at-pallikaranai/ |access-date=2025-11-15 |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-02-21 |title=Actor Prakash Raj to endorse Casagrand's Aquene project |url=https://www.medianews4u.com/actor-prakash-raj-to-endorse-casagrands-aquene-project/ |access-date=2025-11-15 |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Agarwal |first=Cheenu |title=Why real estate brands tap A-list celebrities for trust & visibility |url=https://www.afaqs.com/news/mktg/why-real-estate-brands-tap-a-list-celebrities-for-trust-visibility-8870991 |access-date=2025-11-15 |website=www.afaqs.com |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=www.ETBrandEquity.com |title=Casagrand onboards Nayanthara and Nani as their brand ambassadors |url=https://brandequity.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/advertising/casagrand-onboards-nayanthara-and-nani-as-their-brand-ambassadors/120202007 |access-date=2025-11-15 |website=ETBrandEquity.com |language=en}}</ref>

In 2025, it collaborated with The Hindu on the “Made of Chennai”.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2025-08-15 |title=Catch Kolamaavu Kokila and Saroja at Marina beach today |url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/chennai/catch-kolamaavu-kokila-and-saroja-at-marina-beach-today/article69938045.ece |access-date=2025-11-15 |work=The Hindu |language=en-IN |issn=0971-751X}}</ref> The company also worked with Royal Stag Water on an AI-based festive campaign.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Team |first=afaqs! Content |title=Royal Stag Water launches AI driven festive campaign |url=https://www.afaqs.com/companies/royal-stag-water-launches-ai-driven-festive-campaign-10564270 |access-date=2025-11-15 |website=www.afaqs.com |language=en}}</ref>

The brand partnered with [[Ananda Vikatan]] for the [[Ananda Vikatan Cinema Awards]] 2024.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-06-12 |title=Ananda Vikatan announces the 2024 Ananda Vikatan Cinema Awards to celebrate Tamil cinema's soul {{!}} MediaNews4U |url=https://www.medianews4u.com/ananda-vikatan-announces-the-2024-ananda-vikatan-cinema-awards-to-celebrate-tamil-cinemas-soul/ |access-date=2025-11-15 |language=en-US}}</ref>
